tasks.label: Isaac Sim
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ${workspaceFolder}/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=0 && export PIB_HAND_SIM_ROOT=${workspaceFolder} && ~/isaacsim/isaac-sim.sh --exec ${workspaceFolder}/isaac_sim/autostart.py

tasks.label: ros2_control
tasks.command: echo 'Warte 30s auf Isaac Sim...' && sleep 30 && source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ${workspaceFolder}/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=0 && ros2 launch pib_bringup pib_sim.launch.py
